text:
katie: Quick question — Security Ops got a request to send SIEM exports to a third‑party forensic partner. Proposal idea: partner-facing exports retained 30d, internal raw log bucket kept at 365d. Need an RBAC + KMS gating plan and a short runbook. @ashwin can you advise?

ashwin: Maybe doable. Key concerns: JIT unwrap process for the CMK, scoped S3 buckets, and audit trail for every unwrap/export. Also contract/legal checks for PII.

marco: I'll outline three parts: 1) transform/mask stage, 2) ephemeral export bucket + CMK, 3) lease workflow (timeboxed), + audit sink. Sketch below.

marco: ```
# pseudo-policy for export role
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-siem-exports/partner/*"
}
# CMK usage requirement (pseudo)
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/export-ephemeral"
}
```

ashwin: Add kms:ViaService conditions and require session tag lease_id + expiry. CMK should be dedicated to partner exports with admin-only key policy.

maria: Who will approve analyst leases for running exports? Suggest security lead + oncall for emergency requests, lease max 4h by default.

katie: Good call. Also need product/compliance signoff on retention change — tagging @sanjay-legal.

sanjay-legal: For partner access we need a DPIA if logs can contain PII. Also check data residency clauses for EU partners; a DPA addendum might be required. Provide a scrub checklist for safe exports.

oncall-bot: incident created: #INC-2026-174 — export-access-approval-request — assigned to @ashwin

ashwin: Draft runbook will include: request template, approver list, terraform snippet to provision ephemeral bucket + CMK, unwrap audit steps, and an automated revoke step when lease expires. Link (internal): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ephemeral-export (internal doc).

james-devops: Implementation nit: presigned URLs are easiest for S3 transfer, but still need the presign token encrypted with CMK and rotated. We can store unwrap tokens in Vault with TTL and log retrievals.

maria: Also ensure every unwrap/event writes to audit sink (immutable) and retained 1y for forensic traceability.

katie: Action items: ashwin -> playbook + terraform PR; sanjay-legal -> confirm DPIA/contract checklist; devops -> provision CMK + scoped buckets; infra -> set mask defaults. Target timeline: end of this week?

ashwin: I'll get a draft by Fri EOD. :calendar:

sanjay-legal: Also block enabling partner exports until red-team has done a quick review.

marco: One open question — mask IPs by default in partner exports? My recommendation: yes, default mask_level = 2 unless approved otherwise.

katie: Agreed — mask by default. set mask_level = 2 in transform config.

ashwin: I'll add an OPA/guard snippet to RBAC and include lease checks. Example (pseudo):
```
package exports.auth

allow {
  input.role == "security_analyst"
  input.tags["lease_id"] != ""
  unix_seconds(now) < input.tags.lease_expiry
}
```

maria: :+1:

katie: Thanks everyone — syncing briefly with product/compliance after the draft. We'll track progress in the runbook and follow-up in this thread.
